name: CMS Section Editor - Section Type Is A Dropdown

momentumSections.body:
The donor recognition wall. The names come from **Donors** — on the admin
dashboard that collection sits under /donate, alongside this one.

This entry decides where the wall sits on the page and, via its Heading field,
what the wall is called. It sits after the member quotes and before the closing
ask, so a reader meets the people already behind the fund immediately before
being asked to join them. Move it with the Order field or hide it with the Draft
toggle.

Everything else on the wall is NOT editable in the CMS: the intro paragraph, the
giving levels, the "no donors yet" message, and the heading used when Heading is
blank are `donorsIntro`, `donorTiers`, `donorsEmptyMessage`, and `donorsTitle` in
`src/data/donatePage.json`. Changing any of them needs a developer — **Page
settings** does not carry them, so there is nowhere in the CMS to look.
Every gift goes straight into the programming that brings this community together.
momentumSections.title: Why Support Harvard in Tech?

description: The Momentum Fund section editor, and the reason Section type is a dropdown rather than a text box: the value selects the renderer, and a typo used to cost an editor a section that silently never appeared. The list now carries goal-meter alongside the narrative and slot bands, so adding a live fundraising meter is a choice from a menu rather than a string typed exactly right. Beneath the layout and image fields sits the Goal meter widget ID box that kind uses — kind-specific in the same way layout and image are narrative-specific, so an editor sees every field but only fills the ones their chosen type reads. The schema stays permissive behind this dropdown on purpose: a hand-edited file or a scenario seed carrying an unknown kind is dropped with a build-log line rather than failing the deploy.
